Before the course, you need to be comfortable with a handful of terminal commands. Instead of a reading assignment, play this: a **safe, simulated terminal** that walks you through everything — navigating, creating files and folders, and the git commands we'll use on course day. You can't break anything, and you don't need anything installed.

**Click the terminal and start typing.** Type `help` for commands, `hint` if you're stuck. When you win, post your 🏆 in the [Slack channel](https://join.slack.com/t/agenticaiworkinggroup/shared_invite/zt-45afgdq1j-R8PNZz3SqUZuzgamkYDttQ).

```{=html}
<style>
#tt-wrap {
  border-radius: 10px; overflow: hidden; margin: 1rem 0 2rem 0;
  box-shadow: 0 8px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.35);
  font-family: "JetBrains Mono", "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace;

}

  background: #0d1117; color: #c9d1d9; padding: 1rem; height: 65vh; min-height: 420px;
  overflow-y: auto; font-size: .95rem; line-height: 1.5; cursor: text;
}
#tt-out div { white-space: pre-wrap; word-break: break-word; }

#tt-prompt { color: #58a6ff; white-space: nowrap; }
#tt-input {
  flex: 1; background: transparent; border: none; outline: none; color: #c9d1d9;
  font: inherit; caret-color: #58a6ff; padding: 0;
}
.tt-ok   { color: #3fb950; }
.tt-err  { color: #f85149; }
.tt-info { color: #58a6ff; }
.tt-sys  { color: #d29922; }
.tt-dim  { color: #8b949e; }
.tt-echo { color: #c9d1d9; }
.tt-echo .tt-p { color: #58a6ff; }
</style>

<script src="assets/terminal-game.js"></script>
<script>
(function () {
  const game = createGame();
  const out = document.getElementById("tt-out");
  const input = document.getElementById("tt-input");
  const promptEl = document.getElementById("tt-prompt");
  const screen = document.getElementById("tt-screen");
  const progressEl = document.getElementById("tt-progress");

  const COMMANDS = ["pwd","ls","cd","mkdir","touch","cat","echo","rm","git","gh","clear","help","hint","missions"];
  const GIT_SUBS = ["init","status","add","commit","log","branch","switch","push","pull","merge"];
  const GH_SUBS = ["pr","create","diff","merge"];
  let history = [], hIdx = -1;

  function print(lines) {
    for (const l of lines) {
      const d = document.createElement("div");
      d.textContent = l.t === "" ? " " : l.t;
      if (l.c) d.className = "tt-" + l.c;
      out.appendChild(d);
    }
  }
  function echoCmd(cmd) {
    const d = document.createElement("div");
    d.className = "tt-echo";
    const p = document.createElement("span");
    p.className = "tt-p";
    p.textContent = promptEl.textContent + " ";
    d.appendChild(p);
    d.appendChild(document.createTextNode(cmd));
    out.appendChild(d);
  }
  function refresh() {
    promptEl.textContent = game.promptStr();
    const mi = game._state.missions();
    progressEl.textContent = game._state.isComplete()
      ? "🏆 complete!"
      : "mission " + (mi + 1) + "/" + game.missionCount;
    screen.scrollTop = screen.scrollHeight;
  }

  input.addEventListener("keydown", function (e) {
    if (e.key === "Enter") {
      const cmd = input.value;
      input.value = "";
      echoCmd(cmd);
      if (cmd.trim()) { history.push(cmd); hIdx = history.length; }
      const r = game.run(cmd);
      if (r.clear) out.innerHTML = "";
      print(r.out);
      refresh();
    } else if (e.key === "ArrowUp") {
      e.preventDefault();
      if (hIdx > 0) { hIdx--; input.value = history[hIdx]; }
    } else if (e.key === "ArrowDown") {
      e.preventDefault();
      if (hIdx < history.length - 1) { hIdx++; input.value = history[hIdx]; }
      else { hIdx = history.length; input.value = ""; }
    } else if (e.key === "Tab") {
      e.preventDefault();
      const parts = input.value.split(/\s+/);
      const last = parts[parts.length - 1];
      if (last === "") return;
      let pool;
      if (parts.length === 1) pool = COMMANDS;
      else if (parts[0] === "git") pool = GIT_SUBS.concat(game.cwdEntries());
      else if (parts[0] === "gh") pool = GH_SUBS;
      else pool = game.cwdEntries();
      const matches = pool.filter((c) => c.startsWith(last));
      if (matches.length === 1) {
        parts[parts.length - 1] = matches[0];
        input.value = parts.join(" ");
      } else if (matches.length > 1) {
        print([{ t: matches.join("   "), c: "dim" }]);
        refresh();
      }
    }
  });

  screen.addEventListener("click", function () { input.focus(); });

  print(game.intro());
  refresh();
  input.focus();
})();
</script>
```

## What this covered (your cheat sheet)

| Command | What it does |
|---------|--------------|
| `pwd` | Where am I? |
| `ls` | What's here? |
| `cd <dir>` / `cd ..` / `cd ~` | Move into a folder / up one / home |
| `mkdir <name>` | Make a folder |
| `touch <name>` | Make an empty file |
| `cat <file>` | Print a file's contents |
| `echo "text" > <file>` | Write text into a file (`>>` appends) |
| `git init` | Start tracking a folder with git |
| `git status` | What does git see right now? *(run constantly)* |
| `git add .` | Stage changes for the next snapshot |
| `git commit -m "msg"` | Save the snapshot |
| `git log` | Show history |
| `git switch -c <name>` | Create + move to a new branch |
| `git push -u origin <name>` | Publish a branch to GitHub the first time (`git push` after that) |
| `git pull` | Fetch the latest from GitHub into your current branch |
| `gh pr create` | Open a pull request proposing your branch into `main` |
| `gh pr diff` | **Read the change** — the review step; never skip it |
| `gh pr merge` | Merge what you approved |

: {.striped}

::: {.callout-tip}
## Done? Do the real thing.
The [Setup guide](setup.qmd) walks you through installing git and Claude Code on your actual machine — including creating and pushing a real repo to GitHub. Everything you practiced here works exactly the same, plus a few things a simulation can't teach (like `gh auth login`).
:::
